scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
